deviations.ISAVAILABLEINMDX_FALSE_NONATTRIBUTE_COLU: A column a calendar names, as a primary, associated, or time-related column, is not reported: the calendar uses the column for time intelligence, and a primary column for sorting. Tabular Editor 3's built-in version of the rule does not report a primary or associated column a calendar names either. The source rule does not read calendars, so Tabular Editor reports such a column when it is hidden.
deviations.SET_ISAVAILABLEINMDX_TO_TRUE_ON_NECESSAR: A column a calendar names, as a primary, associated, or time-related column, is reported when IsAvailableInMdx is false, so the two rules stay mirrors. Tabular Editor 3's built-in version of the rule also reports a primary column a calendar names when its IsAvailableInMdx is false. The source rule does not read calendars.
deviations.UNNECESSARY_COLUMNS: A column a calendar names, as a primary, associated, or time-related column, counts as used: the calendar needs it for time intelligence. The source rule does not read calendars, so Tabular Editor reports such a column when it is hidden and nothing else uses it.
deviations.MODEL_SHOULD_HAVE_A_DATE_TABLE: A table that defines a calendar satisfies the rule, as it satisfies Tabular Editor 3's built-in version, since calendar-based time intelligence works without a table marked as a date table. The source rule does not read calendars, so Tabular Editor reports a model whose only calendar table is not marked.
deviations.DATE/CALENDAR_TABLES_SHOULD_BE_MARKED_AS: A table that defines a calendar is not reported, since calendar-based time intelligence works without the table being marked as a date table. The source rule does not read calendars, and Tabular Editor 3 has no version of this rule.
deviations.PROVIDE_FORMAT_STRING_FOR_MEASURES: A measure that plainly returns text is not reported: one whose result, after its last top-level `RETURN`, is a lone string, joins values with `&`, or starts with a function that returns text, such as `FORMAT` or `CONCATENATEX`. The source rule does not read what a measure returns, so Tabular Editor reports such a measure.
